experiment_data.hypothesis: OpenVLA (openvla-7b, OXE pretrained but not LIBERO fine-tuned) untrained baseline on LIBERO-Long — full 5-phase pipeline. Tests whether the convergent routing pattern (R² exit collapse, L1 mixed heads, counterfactual sensitivity) is absent in the OXE-pretrained base. Note: openvla-7b is not a raw LLM — it has seen 970K+ action trajectories from OXE pretraining.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd && python scripts/libero_long_full_pipeline.py --conditions untrained"
